description: Somos una equipo de cinco integrantes con diversidad interdisciplinaria. Contamos con dos programadores, y tres estudiantes de distintas áreas; alimentos, nutrición y minería. Quienes aportan distintas habilidades y miradas para encarar el desafío de la forma más creativa y eficiente.
summary: Athenea is an interactive planning tool for future human exploration of Mars. Our team developed a map of Jezero Crater that brings together orbital imagery, terrain elevation, Perseverance rover observations, geological information, and environmental data. Users can choose scientific destinations, plan a journey from a base and back, and compare routes by distance, travel time, slope, resources, and obstacles. Athenea addresses the challenge of turning complex space datasets into information that explorers can use to decide where to go, what to investigate, and how to organize an extravehicular activity. As new observations and higher-resolution terrain data become available, they can be incorporated to improve planning for future missions.
details:
ATHENEA is an interactive planning tool for future human exploration of Mars. Its current experience focuses on an extravehicular activity (EVA) in Jezero Crater, where astronauts can choose science objectives, position a base, and plan a route that visits the selected stops and returns to the base.

The tool calculates routes using terrain elevation, walking time, slope limits, and obstacles marked by the user. It lets the team compare a faster route with a gentler one and review distance, estimated duration, elevation, return reserve, and resource consumption. It also presents daylight, weather, radiation, and space-weather information alongside the plan.

ATHENEA combines NASA Mars Trek imagery and elevation data with observations from the Perseverance rover and other NASA resources. We built the interface with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Leaflet; the route planner uses an A* search algorithm. The project runs as a web application deployed on Vercel and also has an Electron desktop version.

Its creative contribution is bringing scientific objectives, map data, route planning, and human EVA constraints into one interactive experience. Our team considered terrain resolution, the age and availability of data, walking limits, obstacles, and the need to return to base. ATHENEA helps people explore planning trade-offs and communicate how data from robotic missions can inform future human missions.
